text:
jen: Patio picnic next Tuesday 12pm-2pm? sunny forecast and would be fun to do a potluck + playlist swap. low-key, bring blankets/chairs. :sun_with_face::sandwich:

omar: Love it. i'll bring a big salad and a bluetooth speaker. who wants to curate a playlist? :musical_note:

kai: i'll make a chill afternoon playlist. can people DM song recs? also note: kids welcome if parents bring them.

lina: i'm in! vegetarian + nut-free here. can someone add dietary tags on the sign-up?

marco: can we keep the playlist family-friendly? no explicit lyrics pls.

jen: agreed on family-friendly. putting a tiny form: https://tiny.redwood/patio-picnic-signup  add dish, diet needs, and playlist recs.

sara: RSVP +1 (bringing partner). i'll bring lemon bars (vegan option possible).

events-bot: To reserve the patio, please run `/event reserve --space patio --start 12:00 --end 14:00 --notes "spring picnic"`. Reply here when done.

jen: pinged facilities to hold the space. @facilities any permit or table limits?

facilities: Patio is available and no permit needed for <50 people. We can provide 4 folding tables and 20 chairs. If you'd like picnic blankets, we can loan some. DM for pickup.

omar: budget q: suggested $5-10 donation to cover napkins/utensils? fine to Venmo or submit expenses?

finance-bot: Suggested collection: $7 per person. If organizers cover upfront, submit `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "patio picnic supplies"`. Reimbursements require receipts.

kai: quick poll: frisbee? cornhole? low-key games. react :frisbee: for frisbee, :game_die: for cornhole, :no_entry_sign: for no games.

lina: frisbee please. outdoor games are great but keep clear space for kids.

marco: accessibility note: patio has ramp on the north side, but grass is bumpy. facilities said they can lay out a 10ft mat on request.

jen: good to know. i'll request the mat. also adding a note on the sheet: family area vs music area (lower volume near families).

sara: also can we have sunscreen and bug spray station? I'll bring a small kit.

omar: volunteer to be music host — i'll keep volume moderate and curate so it's family-friendly.

kai: i'll DM song recs. also can we set a 'no live DJ' rule to keep it chill?

jen: noted. final checklist: reserve patio (facilities), sign-up sheet, $7 suggested donation, volunteers for setup + cleanup, playlist recs in DMs. closing sign-ups Monday noon. excited! :tada:

lina: excited too. thanks for organizing jen!

marco: quick reminder: if anyone's bringing salads with dressing, label ingredients for allergens.

jen: added allergen label reminder to the form. See you Tuesday  bring blankets and sun hats! :beach_umbrella:
